card: This PR refactors transaction construction in fee estimator unit tests to use declarative constructors instead of manual field assignments and vector resizing. It addresses imperative test data setup and consolidates repeated transaction submission code across test cases. The change is part of tracking issue #36692 for declarative test data construction, with no impact on production code or test behavior.
evidence: Author description states the PR is part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data') and eliminates boilerplate without altering test transactions or estimates
problem: Fee estimator unit tests construct transactions imperatively by mutating templates or resizing vectors and assigning fields individually, alongside repeated boilerplate for submitting transactions to the estimator.

risk.why: Mistakes could break fee estimation unit tests or cause test flakiness, but cannot affect production consensus, validation, or node behavior.

scope_notes: A small test-only cleanup across two fee estimation unit test files.
summary: Refactors unit test transaction setup in blockpolicyestimator_tests and mempool_fee_estimator_tests to construct inputs and outputs declaratively via constructors rather than in-place mutation. Also consolidates duplicated test transaction submission logic into a shared helper function.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, but the commit messages and description clearly outline the small test refactoring.
